newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIAN M2 MONEY SUPPLY 5.5 PCT UP IN JULY.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIAN M2 MONEY SUPPLY 5.5 PCT UP IN JULY.

text.p: Romania's M2 money supply
went up by 5.5 percent in July, below monthly inflation of 7.5
percent, National Bank (BNR) data showed.
ROMANIAN MONEY SUPPLY JULY JUNE JULY 1995
M2 money supply (bln ROL) 22,576.6 21,405.2 13,352.2
of which foreign currency 5,145.5 4,858.3 2,943.8
NOTES -- Broad money grew by a year-on-year 69.1 percent in
July, when it stepped up 23.5 percent from last December.
The BNR said M1 narrow money, which includes currency
outside banks and demand deposits, rose by 6.7 percent to 7.8
trillion lei at end-July with cash in circulation almost flat
at 3.94 trillion lei.
Demand deposits soared by 14.2 percent to 3.9 trillion lei
at end-July fuelling inflation fears, a BNR report said.
It said household savings -- 7.1 trillion lei in July --
saw a slide in real terms under pressure from troubles in two
Romanian private banks. It said the downward move was also
triggered by a summer holiday mood.
Residents' hard currency deposits took 22.8 percent of
total broad money in July, up from June's 22.2 percent.
-- Mirela Eremia, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
